description: This file defines the NottableString class, which models a string with optional 'not' semantics, supports serialization/deserialization, and includes comparison and matching functionalities within the mockserver project.

classes.name: NottableString
classes.description: Represents a string that can be optionally negated ('not'), supports serialization, comparison, and pattern matching, used within the mockserver framework.

methods.name: serialise
methods.description: Serializes the NottableString to its string representation, considering optional and 'not' flags.

methods.name: deserializeNottableStrings
methods.description: Deserializes an array or list of strings into a list of NottableString objects.

methods.name: serialiseNottableString
methods.description: Converts a NottableString to its string form.

methods.name: serialiseNottableStrings
methods.description: Serializes a collection of NottableString objects into a list of strings.

methods.name: string
methods.description: Creates a NottableString with optional 'not' flag based on input string.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a NottableString marked as 'not'.

methods.name: strings
methods.description: Creates a list of NottableString objects from varargs or collection of strings.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the string value of the NottableString.

methods.name: isNot
methods.description: Indicates if the string is negated ('not').

methods.name: isOptional
methods.description: Indicates if the string is optional (always returns false in this implementation).

methods.name: getParameterStyle
methods.description: Returns the parameter style associated with the string.

methods.name: withStyle
methods.description: Sets the parameter style for the string, disallowing deep object style.

methods.name: capitalize
methods.description: Returns a capitalized version of the string, splitting on hyphens.

methods.name: lowercase
methods.description: Returns a lowercase version of the string.

methods.name: equalsIgnoreCase
methods.description: Checks equality ignoring case.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the string matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides equality to compare with String, NottableString, or schema strings.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code of the object.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the JSON string representation of the object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this NottableString with another based on value.
